A '''Farming Contest Display''' is an {{Uncommon}} Cosmetic that shows the player's [[Farming Contest]] stats.

== Obtaining ==
=== Garden Visitors ===
A '''Farming Contest Display''' can be obtained by giving {{NPCSprite|Jacob}} a filled {{Item|Carrot-Colored Vinyl Set}} while [[Visitor|Visiting]] {{zone|The Garden}}. The next time he visits, a '''Farming Contest Display''' appears as a reward.

== Usage ==
Placing a '''Farming Contest Display''' displays the player's [[Farming Contest]] stats. Right-clicking on the display allows the player to select specific crops to show or pick it back up.
